description: Managed Retreat at Surfer’s Point, California is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Surfrider Foundation. Erosion has been a consistent problem at Surfer’s Point, a popular surfing spot in the City of Ventura, California, for more than 20 years. Multiple options were explored by city and nongovernmental groups, including the Surfrider Foundation. Coverage: Encinitas, CA (2010). The toolkit gives Encinitas, CA as the location, 2010 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
